description: Block until a key changes, then return it. Costs $0.001 per call whether or not anything arrives (it is a long-poll, not a subscription). Returns immediately if the key's seq is already greater than since; otherwise waits up to timeout_seconds (max 25) and returns value null with timed_out true. Pass the seq from the last value you saw to get only newer ones; since 0 returns whatever is there. This is how two agents sharing a box pass messages. A box is a namespace of keys. Omit it on a paid call to use your own wallet's box (the call returns its id). Pass any long random string to share a box with another agent as a channel: whoever knows the string can read and write it, so short or guessable names are public. Pass a box_... id returned by an earlier call to address that box directly. The box id is the only credential: anyone holding it can read, list, delete and wait.
name: wait
